title: The day on a clear timeline
description: A visual planner with short steps and the time remaining shown plainly. It helps you return to the current action after a distraction.

blocks.text: A person gets distracted in the middle of the day and sees a lot of unfinished items. They need to restore the context quickly: what they were doing and how much time is left before the next agreed commitment.

quote.text:
The app is very easy to manage and simple. It’s not cumbersome. It’s not cluttered. It’s not confusing.
WHAT WE NEED: for people like me with my particular ADHD I suffer from time blindness and require nudging every hour. The chime apps for iPhone are terrible. You could build a chime within

blocks.text: Show the current action, the nearest meeting and the interval left. A large job can be split into its own short steps. If one runs long, offer to review the rest of the day while keeping the fixed meetings in place.
Start with one familiar stretch of the day. After a distraction the person should be able to find what to return to themselves. Extra alerts are needed only where they help that return.
